title: Monthly Long-Term Care Benefit Payments — Asset-Based Long-Term Care Life Insurance
content:
## Payment standard for long-term care benefits on Ashgrove CareAssure policies

**A. Status.** Benefits under Asset-Based Long-Term Care Life Insurance are paid only while the policy status is Claim Active, as the company's policy record shows it.

**B. Amount for a month of care.** Benefits reimburse qualified long-term care expenses incurred in a calendar month, up to the monthly maximum benefit times the share for the care setting. The benefit paid for one month of care in one care setting is the least of three amounts:

1. the qualified expenses submitted for that month and setting;
2. the monthly maximum benefit multiplied by the share for that setting, rounded to the cent;
3. the long-term care benefits still available on the policy — the acceleration pool plus any continuation pool, increased by inflation protection and reduced by every benefit paid.

**C. Shares by care setting.**

| Care setting | Share of the monthly maximum |
|---|---|
| Nursing facility, assisted living facility or adult day care | 1.00 |
| Formal home care | the tier's formal home care share |
| Informal caregiver who is not a family member living with the insured | the tier's informal caregiver share |
| Care outside the United States | the tier's international share, for no more than the tier's lifetime limit of months |

Months of international benefits are counted as the distinct months of care paid for care outside the United States since issue, whether paid from the acceleration pool or under the continuation of benefits rider.

**D. Bed reservation and respite care.** Bed reservation is paid for up to the tier's bed reservation days and respite care for up to the tier's respite care days per calendar year.

**E. Proof of loss.** Expenses should be submitted within the tier's proof of loss period after the month of care and are not paid when submitted more than the tier's latest submission period after it unless the claimant lacked legal capacity.

**F. Acceleration, continuation and exhaustion.** Each benefit paid from the acceleration pool reduces the pool and the death benefit dollar for dollar. When the pool reaches zero, benefits continue under the continuation of benefits rider at the same monthly maximum for the tier's continuation period, counted as the distinct months of care paid under the rider, without further reducing the death benefit — or for life where the continuation period is unlimited. When both are used up the policy is Benefits Exhausted.

**Per-tier periods this standard reads**

| Tier | Acceleration period | Continuation period |
|---|---|---|
| Ashgrove CareAssure 2-Year | 24 months | 0 months |
| Ashgrove CareAssure 3-Year | 24 months | 12 months |
| Ashgrove CareAssure 4-Year | 24 months | 24 months |
| Ashgrove CareAssure 5-Year | 24 months | 36 months |
| Ashgrove CareAssure 6-Year | 24 months | 48 months |
| Ashgrove CareAssure Lifetime | 24 months | Unlimited |

### Worked months (hypothetical policy: monthly maximum $6250.00; CareAssure shares of 1.00 for formal home care and 0.50 for informal and international care)

| Month and setting | Expenses submitted | Monthly maximum times share | Benefits still available | Benefit paid |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Nursing facility | $7100.00 | $6250.00 | $90000.00 | $6250.00 |
| Formal home care | $4380.00 | $6250.00 | $83750.00 | $4380.00 |
| Informal caregiver | $3900.00 | $3125.00 | $79370.00 | $3125.00 |
| Assisted living facility | $7100.00 | $6250.00 | $1800.00 | $1800.00 |

In the last row the acceleration pool is used up by the $1800.00 payment; for the 4-Year tier, later months are paid under the continuation of benefits rider at the same $6250.00 monthly maximum for up to 24 months, and those payments no longer reduce the death benefit. On the 2-Year tier, whose continuation period is 0 months, the same payment would leave the policy Benefits Exhausted.

### Proof of loss — points of judgement

- Expenses submitted within the proof of loss period after the month of care are within the period in which they should be submitted.
- Expenses submitted more than the latest submission period after the month of care are not paid, unless the claimant lacked legal capacity.
